<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="zh-CN"><head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#060913">
  <meta name="description" content="猫尼科技，数字化增长与智能技术服务引擎。专注视界狗·帧析引擎 SaaS、企业数字化系统定制与 AI 商业应用。">
  <title>猫尼科技官网 - 数字化增长与智能技术引擎 | 短视频矩阵SaaS与企业系统定制开发</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="assets/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
  <script src="assets/config.js" defer=""></script>
  <style>
    :root {
      color-scheme: dark;
      --bg-deep: #060913;
      --bg-elevated: #0b1120;
      --card-bg: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.72);
      --card-hover: rgba(22, 33, 62, 0.88);
      --text-main: #f8fafc;
      --text-sub: #cbd5e1;
      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
      --line: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.16);
      --line-glow: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45);
      --cyan: #06b6d4;
      --blue: #3b82f6;
      --indigo: #6366f1;
      --purple: #a855f7;
      --emerald: #10b981;
      --amber: #f59e0b;
      --font-sans: 'PingFang SC', 'HarmonyOS Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
      --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, monospace;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: 90px; }
    body {
      margin: 0;
      background-color: var(--bg-deep);
      color: var(--text-main);
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.65;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    /* 全局动态科技网格与极光背景层（解决纯黑死气沉沉） */
    body::before {
      content: "";
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background-image: 
        linear-gradient(to right, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 56px 56px;
      mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 75% at 50% 35%, #000 35%, transparent 100%);
      -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 75% at 50% 35%, #000 35%, transparent 100%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .aurora-bg {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .aurora-blob {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(110px);
      opacity: 0.42;
      animation: floatBlob 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }
    .aurora-blob.b1 {
      width: 680px; height: 680px;
      top: -180px; right: -100px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.55), rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2), transparent 70%);
    }
    .aurora-blob.b2 {
      width: 620px; height: 620px;
      top: 38%; left: -180px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.45), rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15), transparent 70%);
      animation-delay: -6s;
    }
    .aurora-blob.b3 {
      width: 580px; height: 580px;
      bottom: 8%; right: 5%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.38), rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.14), transparent 70%);
      animation-delay: -12s;
    }
    @keyframes floatBlob {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
      50% { transform: translate(-40px, 35px) scale(1.08); }
      100% { transform: translate(30px, -25px) scale(0.95); }
    }

    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    button { font: inherit; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: 0; background: none; }
    h1, h2, h3, h4, p { margin: 0; }
    ::selection { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4); color: #fff; }

    .wrap {
      max-width: 1320px;
      width: calc(100% - 80px);
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    /* 通用流光渐变字 */
    .gradient-text {
      background: linear-gradient(115deg, #ffffff 0%, #7dd3fc 35%, #60a5fa 68%, #c084fc 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }
    .gradient-gold {
      background: linear-gradient(115deg, #fde68a 0%, #38bdf8 55%, #a855f7 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }

    /* 顶部导航栏 */
    .header {
      height: 86px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 48px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.14);
      position: fixed;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      z-index: 50;
      background: rgba(6, 9, 19, 0.78);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    }
    .brand {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }
    .brand small {
      display: block;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 2.5px;
      color: #93c5fd;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }
    .logo-box {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25), rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25));
      border: 1px solid rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.45);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 26px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #93c5fd;
      box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.28);
    }
    .logo-box span { color: #c084fc; margin-left: 1px; }
    .header nav {
      display: flex;
      gap: 36px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-sub);
    }
    .header nav a {
      padding: 8px 4px;
      position: relative;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .header nav a:hover { color: #fff; }
    .header nav a::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan), var(--purple));
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transition: transform 0.25s;
    }
    .header nav a:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

    .login-btn {
      padding: 11px 22px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #fff;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25), rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.25));
      border: 1px solid rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.5);
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
      transition: all 0.25s;
    }
    .login-btn:hover {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #7c3aed);
      border-color: #93c5fd;
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.45);
    }
    .menu-toggle { display: none; font-size: 26px; }

    /* 第一屏 Hero */
    .hero {
      min-height: 920px;
      height: 100svh;
      max-height: 1100px;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 110px 0 90px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    #flow {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .hero-glow {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: 
        radial-gradient(circle at 76% 46%, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.16), rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.14) 32%, transparent 65%),
        linear-gradient(90deg, #060913 0%, rgba(6, 9, 19, 0.88) 42%, rgba(6, 9, 19, 0.25) 78%, transparent 100%);
      z-index: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 3;
      max-width: 780px;
    }
    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
      color: #7dd3fc;
      box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.18);
    }
    .status-dot {
      width: 8px; height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #38bdf8;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px #38bdf8, 0 0 24px #38bdf8;
      display: inline-block;
      animation: pulseDot 2s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes pulseDot {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
      50% { transform: scale(1.35); opacity: 0.65; }
    }
    .hero-brand {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 4px;
      color: #93c5fd;
      margin: 28px 0 14px;
    }
    h1 {
      font-size: clamp(44px, 4.8vw, 72px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.18;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    }
    .hero-description {
      font-size: 20px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      color: #dbeafe;
      margin-top: 26px;
      font-weight: 400;
      max-width: 680px;
    }
    .hero-description strong {
      color: #7dd3fc;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 38px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .button {
      padding: 16px 30px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      transition: all 0.25s ease;
    }
    .button.primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #38bdf8 0%, #3b82f6 50%, #6366f1 100%);
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -5px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.55);
      border: 1px solid rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.4);
    }
    .button.primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 38px -5px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.75);
    }
    .button.secondary {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.75);
      color: #e2e8f0;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    }
    .button.secondary:hover {
      border-color: #38bdf8;
      color: #fff;
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.9);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .hero-badges {
      display: flex;
      gap: 14px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: 42px;
    }
    .hero-badge-item {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 10px 18px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.68);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #e2e8f0;
    }
    .hero-badge-item b {
      color: #38bdf8;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
    }

    .orbit-label {
      position: absolute;
      right: 6%;
      bottom: 14%;
      z-index: 3;
      padding: 16px 22px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: rgba(11, 17, 32, 0.75);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
      color: #bae6fd;
      box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    }
    .orbit-label small {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #cbd5e1;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    /* 通用章节头部（大气排版） */
    .section {
      padding: 115px 0;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .section-heading {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-end;
      gap: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 60px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .kicker {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      color: #38bdf8;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
    }
    h2 {
      font-size: clamp(34px, 3.6vw, 50px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.25;
      letter-spacing: -1px;
      color: #ffffff;
    }
    .section-intro {
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      color: var(--text-sub);
      max-width: 480px;
    }
    .section-intro small {
      display: inline-block;
      margin-top: 10px;
      padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12);
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #93c5fd;
    }

    /* 第二屏：双轮业务矩阵 */
    .business-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 32px;
    }
    .business-card {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(19, 30, 58, 0.85) 0%, rgba(10, 15, 29, 0.92) 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.28);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 42px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      min-height: 520px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    }
    .business-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.65);
      box-shadow: 0 25px 60px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.18);
    }
    .business-card.custom {
      background: linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(31, 22, 56, 0.85) 0%, rgba(11, 15, 30, 0.92) 100%);
      border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
    }
    .business-card.custom:hover {
      border-color: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.7);
      box-shadow: 0 25px 60px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2);
    }
    .card-top {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .chip {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.18);
      border: 1px solid rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.45);
      color: #bae6fd;
    }
    .business-card.custom .chip {
      background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.18);
      border-color: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.45);
      color: #e9d5ff;
    }
    .index {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.45);
    }

    /* 卡片中部动态视觉图形 */
    .visual-stage {
      margin: 34px 0;
      padding: 26px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: rgba(6, 9, 19, 0.65);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.16);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-around;
      gap: 14px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .visual-stage::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15), transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .stage-node {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 14px 18px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8);
      border: 1px solid rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.35);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #e0f2fe;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .stage-node small {
      display: block;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #7dd3fc;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
    }
    .stage-arrow {
      color: #38bdf8;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .overline {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      color: #38bdf8;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .business-card.custom .overline { color: #c084fc; }
    .business-copy h3 {
      font-size: 32px;
      font-weight: 800;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      color: #ffffff;
    }
    .business-copy > p:not(.overline) {
      font-size: 17px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      color: var(--text-sub);
    }
    .tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 26px 0 30px;
    }
    .tags span {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.24);
      color: #f1f5f9;
    }
    .text-link {
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #38bdf8;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 6px 0;
      transition: gap 0.25s;
    }
    .business-card.custom .text-link { color: #d8b4fe; }
    .text-link:hover { gap: 20px; }

    .delivery {
      margin-top: 32px;
      padding: 24px 34px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.75);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .delivery > span {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #93c5fd;
    }
    .delivery p {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #f8fafc;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .delivery b { color: #38bdf8; font-size: 18px; }

    /* 第三屏：技术底蕴与演进历程 */
    .journey {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11, 17, 32, 0.85), rgba(6, 9, 19, 0.95));
      border-block: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .big-stat strong {
      font-size: 56px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #38bdf8, #a855f7);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }
    .big-stat strong span {
      font-size: 24px;
      letter-spacing: 0;
    }
    .big-stat p {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-sub);
      margin-top: 6px;
    }
    .timeline {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
      padding-top: 20px;
    }
    .timeline article {
      position: relative;
      padding: 32px 28px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.68);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.18);
      border-top: 4px solid #3b82f6;
      transition: transform 0.25s, border-color 0.25s;
    }
    .timeline article:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.55);
    }
    .timeline article.current {
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(30, 41, 82, 0.85), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9));
      border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.45);
      border-top: 4px solid #c084fc;
      box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.18);
    }
    .year {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 28px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #7dd3fc;
    }
    .timeline article.current .year { color: #e9d5ff; }
    .year small {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: #94a3b8;
    }
    .timeline h3 {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin: 18px 0 12px;
      color: #ffffff;
    }
    .timeline article > p:not(.year) {
      color: var(--text-sub);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.75;
    }
    .era {
      display: inline-block;
      margin-top: 22px;
      padding: 5px 12px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      color: #93c5fd;
    }
    .current .era {
      background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2);
      color: #f3e8ff;
    }

  /* 第四屏（极简左列 + 右侧图形化流程图）：6大技术底座 */
    .product-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.85fr 1.25fr;
      gap: 40px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .product-tabs {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .product-tab {
      text-align: left;

        const scale = Math.min(width * 0.42, height * 0.52) * (mobile ? 1.35 : 1.05);
        const t = time * 0.00018;

        // 中心多层炫彩能量辉光
        const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 10, cx, cy, scale * 1.25);
        glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.28)');
        glow.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.16)');
        glow.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.08)');
        glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(6, 9, 19, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = glow;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

        // 3D 全息流光波带
        const bands = 36;
        for (let band = 0; band < bands; band++) {
          const angle = (band / bands) * Math.PI * 2 + t;
          ctx.beginPath();
          for (let j = 0; j <= 140; j++) {
            const u = (j / 140) * Math.PI * 2;
            const r = scale * (0.68 + 0.14 * Math.sin(u * 3 + angle * 2));
            const x = Math.cos(u) * r;
            const y = Math.sin(u) * r;
            const z = Math.sin(angle) * scale * 0.34;
            const xx = x * Math.cos(angle * 0.35) + z;
            const yy = y * 0.85 + Math.cos(angle) * scale * 0.22;
            const px = cx + xx * 0.88 + yy * 0.28;
            const py = cy + yy * 0.9 - xx * 0.2;
            if (j === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
            else ctx.lineTo(px, py);

            if (j % 7 === 0) {
              const alpha = 0.25 + 0.55 * ((Math.sin(u + angle) + 1) / 2);
              ctx.fillStyle = band % 2 === 0
                ? `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${alpha})`
                : `rgba(192, 132, 252, ${alpha})`;
              ctx.fillRect(px, py, 2, 2);
            }
          }
          const hue = 195 + (band / bands) * 85;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `hsla(${hue}, 92%, 68%, ${0.14 + 0.1 * Math.sin(angle)})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.1;
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        // 悬浮算力星辰粒子
        for (let i = 0; i < 75; i++) {
          const x = (((Math.sin(i * 127.1) * 43758.5453) % 1 + 1) % 1) * width;
          const y = (((Math.sin(i * 311.7) * 13758.5453) % 1 + 1) % 1) * height;
          const pulse = 0.2 + 0.55 * ((1 + Math.sin(t * 12 + i)) / 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = i % 3 === 0
            ? `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${pulse})`
            : i % 3 === 1
              ? `rgba(168, 85, 247, ${pulse})`
              : `rgba(250, 204, 21, ${pulse * 0.8})`;
          const size = i % 6 === 0 ? 2.6 : 1.5;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(x, y, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }

        frameId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
      }

      window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
      resize();
      frameId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
